relationship_to_r9.rationale: R9 is a sealed artefact. Adding concepts by editing it would break every hash reference recorded against it since R9. This layers on top, in the same way PRODUCT_CONTRACT_V1 supersedes V0 without editing it.

purpose: Complete the mid-level layer so the redefined secondary has a candidate in every dimension it can activate. Before this, 7 of 9 dimensions had no representative and secondary was structurally empty for them.

broad.fruity.owner_decision: ROUND2-D7 approved: fruity is the largest dimension and the only one where honest middle-level output was impossible.

taste.reason: The taste dimension has exactly one member, sensory.bitter. A representative would say taste-family where the system can already say bitter, which loses specificity. The owner further noted bitter appears across all contexts, so a taste-family label carries no information.

not_a_measurement: These are naming decisions for equivalence classes the topology already contains. They assert no sensory fact and were not derived from data.
what_this_does_not_do: No within-class discrimination. The six concepts share their siblings' feature vectors and join the equivalence classes rather than splitting them.
No relation edges. The 312 occurrences carrying a REQUIRES_RELATION_EDGE specificity status still require one.
No change to what the system knows, only to what it can say when it has dimension-level support.

measurement_rule_exemption.rule: The representation-progress rule requires max_class_size, equivalence_class_count and per-column variance to improve together.
measurement_rule_exemption.exemption: This change is expressibility, not representation. It is expected to leave all three unchanged and must not be judged by that rule.

deterministic_selection_rule.problem: nutty_cocoa now carries two representatives, broad.chocolate and broad.nutty.
deterministic_selection_rule.rule: Lexicographic on concept id. For nutty_cocoa this selects broad.chocolate.
deterministic_selection_rule.status: APPLIED, and recorded here so it is a declared rule rather than registry insertion order.

connected_defect_scan.assessment: All use broad.citrus, broad.nutty or broad.chocolate as fixtures. None enumerate the total or assert a count, so adding concepts does not break them.
connected_defect_scan.public_project_status: reports 130 canonical concepts and 92 active sensory attributes, which are database-layer counts unrelated to this 82-entry registry. No update required.
connected_defect_scan.assessment_scripts: All filter by role rather than by count.
